cards.text: The flood is over, and God has set His rainbow in the clouds as a sign (Genesis 9:13). Now meet the sons of Noah who came out of the ark: Shem, Ham and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.

cards.question: Shem, Ham and Japheth are Noah's three sons. From them, the whole ___ was populated.

cards.text: Now Noah, a man of the soil, gets to planting. I bet you hand that man a patch of dirt and he lights UP, the way I do when somebody slides me a fresh bowl of dough.

cards.question: Noah, the man of the soil, plants a ___.

cards.text: Noah drinks some of the wine from his vineyard, becomes drunk and uncovers himself inside his tent. This part is heavy, friend.

cards.question: Ham, the father of Canaan, sees his father's nakedness. What does Ham do next?

answers.text: He tells his two brothers outside

cards.text: Shem and Japheth take a garment and lay it across their shoulders. They're going to cover their dad, and they've got a plan.

cards.question: Shem and Japheth have the garment across their shoulders. How do they get to their father?
When Noah wakes up from his drunkenness, he learns what his youngest son had done to him. Then Noah speaks a curse. Who does Noah curse?

cards.text: Noah goes on: "A servant of servants shall he be to his brothers." Then he declares, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem!"

cards.question: Right after blessing the LORD, the God of Shem, Noah's words name Canaan as Shem's servant.
Noah's words turn to Japheth next. What does Noah say God may do for Japheth?

cards.text: Then Noah adds, "…may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant."

cards.question: After the flood, Noah lives ___ more years.

cards.text: So Noah lives a total of 950 years, and then he dies.

Then comes the account of Noah's sons Shem, Ham and Japheth and the sons born to them after the flood, clan by clan and nation by nation. One name stands out: Nimrod, son of Ham's son Cush, a mighty hunter before the LORD, who built Nineveh. From these clans, the nations of the earth spread out after the flood. Friend, that's not a family tree anymore, that's a family reunion that needs a MAP.
